security-verification.title: Security verification
security-verification.description: This verification will help you ensure that no one has messed with the encryption parameters between you and this user (public keys / security codes).
security-verification.step-1-description:
Exchange these codes via a safe communications channel (other than this app) or physically.
Verify if both your and {{name}}'s code are exactly the same on both devices.
(your device's A must match their device's B and vice versa).
security-verification.step-2-description: Your conversations are only secure if both pairs do match. Mismatch is a critical alert. Once verified successfully, there's no need to redo this in the future.

login.register-hint: I don't have an account yet

register.encouragement: Your name and login will only be visible to users you who discover you - and this requires knowing your exact login or full name.
register.login-input: Unique login (only letters, numbers and underscores; no spaces)
register.email-phone-hint: At least one is required (phone recommended)
register.email-phone-settings: Make other users able to find me by my (this data will always remain publically hidden, even if you enable these options)

block.user: You will no longer receive notifications or see this user's messages, even in the group chats. The user will be removed from your Conversation list.
block.group: You will be removed from the group and it will be gone from your Conversation list. No one will be able to re-add you, unless you unblock the group.

server-unavailable.description: It's worth checking your internet connection, but most likely the app server is currently down. No data can be loaded. Contact the administrator if the issue persists.

no-internet.description: This data can't be loaded until you're online again

data-unavailable.description: Couldn't load data - this might due to a bad URL, missing permissions, or a problem with the server or internet connection.

not-found.description: The data you wanted to view hasn't been found. This is likely due to a bad URL or a problem with internet/server connection. Try going back to the app home page.

bad-url.description: Try going back to the home page

unauthorized.description: The server has denied access. Try logging in again.

server-error.description: The server has returned an unknown error. Contact the administrator if the issue persists.

data-invalid.description: Provided data is invalid. Check the if the input is correct.

unknown.description: Please contact the administrator if the issue persists.

logout-failed.description: An error occurred while logging out. If necessary, try erasing the browser cookies and data.

session-expired.description: Please log in again. Otherwise, you will only be able to browse old data
